# FlowGroove

> Real-time setlist sync, metronome and tuner for cover bands — free, offline-first,
> and built by a working musician. One change on your phone lands on every bandmate's
> screen before you finish the first chord. Web, iOS and Android.

FlowGroove keeps a band's repertoire in sync live: setlists, song keys/BPM, and notes
update across everyone's devices instantly and keep working when the venue WiFi doesn't.
It's free for indie musicians, with no ads and no paywall on the core; a solo developer
builds it and Ko-fi tips keep the servers running.

## What it is
- [Home](https://flowgroove.app/): overview, screenshots, features
- [About](https://flowgroove.app/about/): who builds it and why
- [FAQ](https://flowgroove.app/faq/): free tier, offline use, sync speed, who it's for
- [Roadmap](https://flowgroove.app/roadmap/): what's planned next

## Features (docs)
- [Setlists](https://flowgroove.app/wiki/setlists/): build and share setlists that sync live
- [Songs](https://flowgroove.app/wiki/songs/): repertoire with keys, BPM and structure
- [Bands](https://flowgroove.app/wiki/bands/): shared band libraries and membership
- [Metronome](https://flowgroove.app/wiki/metronome/): adjustable BPM, time signatures, accent patterns
- [Tuner](https://flowgroove.app/wiki/tuner/): built-in instrument tuner
- [Concert Mode](https://flowgroove.app/wiki/concert-mode/): big, dark-stage-readable performance view
- [Profile](https://flowgroove.app/wiki/profile/): account and personal settings
